limitations: No completed cold output for either revision; warm/incremental/recovery/concurrent-tenant scenarios were not run.
Baseline SIGKILL leaves a stale RUNNING receipt; Docker OOMKilled true/exit 137 establish application OOM even when last sampled kernel counters precede the kill.
Kernel memory charge includes file pages and kernel memory; sampled RSS and cgroup counters are distinct, not interchangeable.
More retained artifacts at timeout indicate further partial progress, not complete-workload throughput or output equivalence.
Component/helper durations overlap and must not be summed.
